Full pre-registration sweep: Not ready — 2 BLOCKING issues, 2 NON-BLOCKING HYGIENE issues. Counts by severity: BLOCKING 2; NON-BLOCKING HYGIENE 2; SUGGESTION 0. Counts by issue type: factual 2; structural 1; scope-related 1. Findings: 1. (scope-related, BLOCKING) The staged artifacts overstate the universe as “continental Antarctica,” but the CSV/source table includes Antarctic island stations. Evidence: the cited Wikipedia master’s “Permanent active stations” table has 43 rows and includes island locations such as King George Island, Laurie Island/South Orkney Islands, Anvers Island, Adelaide Island, and Ross Island; the same page has a separate “Subantarctic stations” subsection with 9 rows. Locators: source URL https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Research_stations_in_Antarctica, Permanent active stations table rows around lines 216–265; Orcadas at Laurie Island/South Orkney Islands around line 253; Palmer at Anvers Island around line 254; Rothera at Adelaide Island around line 257; Subantarctic stations section around lines 266–286. Impact: the 43-row CSV is source-backed, but table_title, temporal_note, db_analog, claim_type_rationale, collection_summary, decision_log, and audit_trail repeatedly encode the predicate as location_scope='continental_antarctica'. That predicate is false for many staged rows. If the intended query is active year-round stations “in Antarctica,” the fix is prose/db_analog scope repair, not row deletion: frame the universe as the master’s “Permanent active stations” table / Antarctic stations including Antarctic islands, while excluding the separate Subantarctic stations subsection. 2. (structural, BLOCKING) curation.json is missing minimum required curation fields. Evidence: datasets/pkdb_bench/docs/agent_handoff_bundle.md lists minimum required curation fields as claim_type, collection_summary, source_coverage_notes, decision_log, normalization_decisions, and open_questions. The staged curation.json has claim_type, collection_summary, source_coverage_notes, decision_log, and audit_trail, but no normalization_decisions or open_questions. Locators: agent_handoff_bundle.md around “Minimum required curation fields” and “curation.json must include...” sections; local staged artifact datasets/pkdb_bench/staging/active_year_round_research_stations_in_antarctica.curation.json. Impact: registration should not proceed until those required fields exist. Add normalization rules for Station Name footnote/link stripping, Country multi-value delimiter, Location visible-text preservation, Year Established current-facility nuance, and the master-table partition rule; add open_questions documenting the resolved continental-vs-Antarctic-islands scope and any known source caveats. 3. (factual, NON-BLOCKING HYGIENE) Concordia’s Country cell is semantically correct but not visible-master-text verbatim as currently claimed. Evidence: the cited source renders Concordia’s Country cell as separate Italy and France entries in the same table cell; the raw wikitext uses {{Flagu|Italy}}
{{Flagu|France}}. The CSV has “Italy/France,” and curation prose says this is preserved verbatim. Locator: source URL https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Research_stations_in_Antarctica, Concordia row around lines 232–233; raw table cell confirmed as Italy line break France. Impact: the country values are correct, but either the CSV should use the project’s usual normalized multi-value delimiter (for example “Italy; France”) or the curation should explicitly document “Italy/France” as a normalized delimiter. Remove “verbatim” claims for that cell unless the staged value is changed to the exact visible text convention. 4. (factual, NON-BLOCKING HYGIENE) Out-of-scope partition counts in active prose are stale/inexact. Evidence: the cited master currently parses as 43 Permanent active rows, 9 Subantarctic rows, 45 Summer-only active rows, and 69 Inactive rows. The staged collection_summary and temporal_note say summer-only is “~57” and inactive is “~50+.” Locators: source URL https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Research_stations_in_Antarctica, Subantarctic section around lines 266–286; Summer-only active stations section beginning around lines 287–335; Inactive stations section beginning around lines 662–675; local audit read_html parse of the cited source. Impact: this does not change the 43-row in-scope universe, but the set_filter justification depends on accurate partition framing. Update the out-of-scope counts to 45 and 69, or use explicitly approximate language without stale numeric claims. Passed checks: - CSV shape is 43 rows x 4 columns, with unique Station Name primary key. - The live cited source’s first “Permanent active stations” table parses to 43 rows; the CSV matches all 43 row names, locations, years, and single-country cells after footnote stripping. - Year Established nuances flagged in the handoff are supported by the master table values: Halley = 2013, SANAE IV = 1997, Vernadsky = 1994. - Compound entries are present in the source and staged as single rows: Eduardo Frei and Villa Las Estrellas, GARS, and Concordia. - source_count = 1 matches len(source_urls), and the chosen source is the most direct Wiki-family source found for the row universe. - query_category = set_filter and operation_type = filter are defensible once the scope predicate is repaired from “continental” to “Permanent active stations table / Antarctic stations excluding separate Subantarctic table.” - Science/Polar Research is acceptable under domain_taxonomy.md because the answer entities are research facilities; Geography/Polar Regions would be defensible but is not required. Minimal fixes: 1. Replace “continental Antarctica” / location_scope='continental_antarctica' framing with “master Permanent active stations table / Antarctic stations, including Antarctic islands; excluding the separate Subantarctic stations subsection” across draft.json and curation.json. 2. Add required curation.json normalization_decisions and open_questions fields; optionally mirror existing audit_trail into the established audit_trail_pre_curation naming used by recent artifacts. 3. Normalize/document Concordia Country as a multi-value country cell rather than verbatim “Italy/France.” 4. Correct out-of-scope partition counts to current source counts: Subantarctic 9, Summer-only active 45, Inactive 69. Verdict: Not ready. The row set is substantially correct, but registration should wait for the scope predicate and curation-contract repairs.
